response.text:
I'll propose a correction for journal 2034, which is the root cause of this finding.

The journal 2034 lines are: DR 5200 Professional Fees 7439.39; CR 2000 Accounts Payable 7448.39. The invoice INV_AMT is 7448.39, so the AP credit is correct and the expense debit is understated by 9.00. The true expense should be 7448.39. The correction is a one-sided debit of 9.00 to 5200 in an open period (11, the period of the original journal, which is open). This keeps the original journal untouched and makes the expense side match the invoice.

Caveat: the original journal 2034 is itself out of balance by 9.00, so the group (original + correction) balances: DR 7439.39 + 9.00 = 7448.39 = CR 7448.39. The correction does not void the invoice and does not change any status.

One point to note for the audit: the finding says the root cause is the same as journal 2034, so this correction addresses the imbalance rather than any duplicate. I am not voiding anything.
